purpose: Isolated strict r2 attention experiment; no production integration or certification

abi_evidence.method: Static PTX, generated header, clean host MLIR and read-only x86-64 object disassembly; no CPU stub or GPU execution
abi_evidence.generated_cpp: No generated .cpp exists in this export; the exported .o was inspected directly instead
abi_evidence.host_scale_evidence: 0x436 stores incoming xmm0 unchanged; 0x450/0x462 put its address in device parameter slot 4
abi_evidence.host_fast_divmod_evidence: 0x491 loads 0x0000000100000001; 0x4bd writes it, 0x4c2 writes u16 zero; 0x467/0x47a put its address in slot 5
abi_evidence.host_grid_block_evidence: .rodata.cst16+0x40 is little-endian u32[3,12,14,128]; 0x4a9 writes remaining block dimensions [1,1]

device_abi.parameter_5_padding: Last two bytes are host padding, explicitly zeroed by Rust; PTX does not load parameter 5
device_abi.scale: Natural FP32 qk_scale*qk_scale; never multiply by LOG2_E

probe.reference: Existing independent unblocked FP32 GPU reference with 64 CPU-sampled rows; same deterministic inputs and batch-shared RoPE
probe.timing: Event pairs enqueued for all iterations, one final synchronization; separate attention-only and RoPE-inclusive comparisons
probe.acceptance: A passing attention probe does not replace the precision audit, TF3/ONNX full-head numerical gates or clean production ABBA
